Thank you for telling me. Saying that out loud is not easy.

A frightening thought is not the same as wanting to act on it. Thoughts like this can arrive uninvited and feel appalling, and having one does not make you a bad person. Many people have thoughts like this and never act on them.

It helps to say it to someone real — your therapist, or someone you trust. If these thoughts keep coming back, or they frighten you a lot, it is worth talking them through properly with someone who can help.
